text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At summer camp, Manhattan Cafe is
exerting herself something
fierce.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Under...stood. Thank you for today. But,
um...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Have I improved... this summer?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Okay... Well in that case... there's
something I'd like you to do for me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's very... important.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe asked me to come watch
her race tonight. When I
reach the meeting
place, I notice that she is alone.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you for coming... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Everything has... led to tonight. I need
you... to see this.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No, not her. The truth is...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The other one... is here. Right... behind
you...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Don't turn around. It's... after you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
As long as it can see me...
you are safe. It
may try to draw you away...
however...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I don't know. But...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I won't let it happen.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to beat it tonight... and put an
end to this. Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Do you believe me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I swallow hard. I have no idea what will
happen if she loses, but I
know that there
is only one answer to the question at
hand.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you... Shall we get going?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple.
We'll run to that big
rock, and then back. The
first one to reach
you again is the winner.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's fast... But...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose. I've also... gotten faster.
And
it's all thanks to your
guidance...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'm ready. Can you give us the signal?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I nod and take a step back, then raise my
arm to give the starting
signal.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She takes a deep breath, then dashes off
into the night. Her silhouette melts into
the murky darkness, just as I have
witnessed
many times before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see only her shadow, yet strangely, I
think I see another set of
footprints behind
hers, as if someone is giving chase.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can see the sand being kicked up behind
them, and it indicates that they are about
neck-and-neck. Cafe leads barely, a fierce
look
emblazoned across her visage.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(You really are... fast. You've always...
wanted to run like this, haven't
you?)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(To run like this... To get faster...
But you
couldn't tell anyone...
because no one can
see you...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(Oh! So that's why... you needed my
trainer...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(If anyone,
Trainer would certainly believe
in you...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You won't be able to see her... No one
can, no matter how hard they
look...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm the only one... who ever notices her.
She... she remains far away,
even from
me...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I was sure... that you couldn't see her.
But
it really feels like... you can...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(You wanted... to be noticed... Noticed by
Trainer... But...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A sudden strong wind kicks up the sand,
blocking my view. The runners should be
arriving at my position any moment now,
but I can't
see a thing.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I won't let you... take Trainer away!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Hraaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, and as though it was a figment
of my imagination, the wind
storm
subsides, and the beach is calm once more.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It... no, she... has gone. Probably because... she was able to do what she'd always wanted...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: And that was... to run like everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Like everyone at the academy... To win
and lose... To get faster and
stronger...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
But... No one was able to acknowledge
her.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If only... I had noticed sooner, then she
might not have gone after
you...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I think... she is...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You're really...
quite the unusual person...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You... must've been scared this whole
time... Yet you were able to
move on... like
it was nothing.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(Someone like you... is what she needed...
and what I...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
There's a shooting star... It's like she's
running off... into the night...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer... Would it be okay if... we
stayed here a bit longer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All falls silent, and Manhattan Cafe and I
gaze upon the night sky for
a while. This
has truly become an unforgettable summer
camp.
